name: Clover
summary: Bright, friendly fintech landing page with lime-glow gradients, an italic centred headline, floating 3D coin renders and soft white chart cards.

fonts.pairing: General Sans medium for headings with an italic H1, Inter for body and small italic disclaimers

signature: draggable floating 3D lime coin renders flanking the centred hero
every section washed with a soft diagonal lime-to-white gradient plus a hand-drawn scribble doodle
black gradient pill buttons with an arrow glyph against the pale lime field
imagery: glossy 3D coins, white dashboard chart cards with lime and dark-olive series, no photography
layout_grid: 1080px content, 60px side padding, 96px section padding, 3-column card grids, alternating 2-column feature rows
